title: asaptic.tender.v1
description: Public data contract for the Asaptic tender feed (https://asaptic.com/tender/rows.json). One envelope per published issue; each row is the 11-field public listing shape. Detail beyond these 11 fields is access-gated and not part of this contract.

generated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this issue of the feed was generated.

issue_id.description: Weekly issue identifier, ISO week form.

market.description: Primary market of this feed build.

total.description: Number of rows published in this issue.

withheld.description: Number of listings withheld from publication in this issue.

asaptic_id.description: Stable Asaptic listing id. Synthetic test fixtures use the AT-TEST- prefix and never collide with live ids.

summary_en.description: Sanitized English summary of the requirement. Generic procurement language only.

value_band.description: Estimated value band in HKD-equivalent, or null when no estimate is published.

closing_bucket.description: Coarse time-to-close bucket. Exact closing timestamps are not part of the public contract.

lead_ok.description: Whether Asaptic accepts supplier interest against this listing.

new_this_issue.description: True if the listing first appeared in the current weekly issue.

sort_key.description: Opaque 64-hex stable sort key. Carries no recoverable information.
